build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that creates two upside-down jars with balls and a catching basket
create_element_with_ball: create a jar-like element with tilted static bars, a dynamic ball, and a movable handle bar
add_static_bar: add a static bar to the PHYRE scene with configurable scale, angle, and position
update_task_relationships: update the task objective to make two balls touch using SpatialRelationship.TOUCHING
set_solution_tier: set the task metadata to SolutionTier.TWO_BALLS for two-ball puzzle categorization
